data.one_liner: Print customizable colored badges to the terminal for CLI apps.
data.what_it_does: Generates ANSI‑styled badge strings with label and message. Provides built‑in themes and methods to customize colors and layout.
use_when: You need quick visual status indicators in a Dart/Flutter CLI tool
You want zero‑dependency, cross‑platform terminal output
avoid_when: Building a GUI or web UI
Needing complex graphics or image badges

alternatives.name: console
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides general terminal styling and color utilities, can be used to build similar badges without a dedicated package
